sentences.text: I dag har Lars en time om naturen. Elevene skal lære om elver, skog og strøm.
sentences.english: Today Lars has a lesson about nature. The pupils will learn about rivers, forest and electricity.

sentences.text: Norge har mye natur. Vi har fjell, fjorder, skog og elver.
sentences.english: Norway has a lot of nature. We have mountains, fjords, forest and rivers.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Vannet i elvene kommer fra fjellet. Når det regner, blir det mye vann.
sentences.english: The water in the rivers comes from the mountains. When it rains, there is a lot of water.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Hva gjør vi med vannet?
sentences.english: What do we do with the water?
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Vi lager strøm. Vannet går, og det lager strøm.
sentences.english: We make electricity. The water runs, and it makes electricity.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Så vi har lys fordi vi har vann!
sentences.english: So we have light because we have water!
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Ja. Derfor er regn bra for oss.
sentences.english: Yes. That is why rain is good for us.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Etter timen går klassen en tur i skogen. Den er stor og mørk.
sentences.english: After the lesson the class goes for a walk in the forest. It is big and dark.

sentences.text: Her er naturen også. Vi må være snille.
sentences.english: Here is nature too. We must be kind.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Hvordan kan vi være snille, Lars?
sentences.english: How can we be kind, Lars?
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Vi kan gå på veien, og vi kan ta med oss maten hjem.
sentences.english: We can walk on the road, and we can take our food home with us.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Sam går med klassen. Han er glad i fjell og vann.
sentences.english: Sam walks with the class. He is fond of mountains and water.

sentences.text: I USA har vi også fjell og vann. Men jeg liker Norge veldig godt.
sentences.english: In the USA we also have mountains and water. But I like Norway very much.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Fordi det regner mye!
sentences.english: Because it rains a lot!
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Ja, kanskje. Regn lager vann, og vann lager lys.
sentences.english: Yes, maybe. Rain makes water, and water makes light.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Om kvelden er Lars trøtt. Han drikker te, og han tenker på timen.
sentences.english: In the evening Lars is tired. He drinks tea, and he thinks about the lesson.

sentences.text: Hva lærte elevene i dag?
sentences.english: What did the pupils learn today?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: De lærte at vi har lys fordi vi har regn. Og at vi må være snille.
sentences.english: They learned that we have light because we have rain. And that we must be kind.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Det er en god time! Kanskje elevene husker den lenge.
sentences.english: That is a good lesson! Maybe the pupils will remember it for a long time.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Jeg håper det. Jeg husker selv timer fra da jeg var liten.
sentences.english: I hope so. I myself remember lessons from when I was small.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Først leste Sam bokmål, men så leste han nynorsk også. Han ville lære begge måter. Han forstår dialekter, og alle er bra.
sentences.english: First Sam read Bokmål, but then he read Nynorsk too. He wanted to learn both ways. He understands dialects, and all are good.

sentences.text: Menigheten inviterer til gudstjeneste. Alle er velkomne, og vi er sammen, ikke alene.
sentences.english: The congregation invites to the service. Everyone is welcome, and we are together, not alone.

sentences.text: Vi skriver bokmål og nynorsk, og vi forstår begge godt.
sentences.english: We write Bokmål and Nynorsk, and we understand both well.

sentences.text: Mel, salt og gjær: sett deigen riktig. Smak på brødet.
sentences.english: Flour, salt and yeast: put the dough right. Taste the bread.

sentences.text: Anna tenkte på sykehuset og på valget sitt. Nils vil bo nær havet og spise tørrfisk. Alle er velkomne i kirka.
sentences.english: Anna thought of the hospital and of her choice. Nils wants to live near the sea and eat dried fish. Everyone is welcome in the church.
